description: Bottlenecks is a dataset listed in Caltrans GIS Data hub, an open geospatial data hub of a state transportation department, published or maintained by Caltrans. Bottleneck Mapping is a subproject of the Mobility Performance Report, which is one of the products of the Mobility Performance Reporting and Analysis Program (MPRAP). The Mobility Performance Report is prepared by the California Department of Transportation (Caltrans) and District staff to provide detailed data about highway system performance related to congestion and mobility. Coverage: California, United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Caltrans. Its keywords are Barriers, California Department of Transportation, California State Transportation Agency, CalSTA, Caltrans, CAOpenData, Chokepoints, Impediments. The bounding box given is -122.3283,32.5915,-116.9642,39.1282. The hub shows 2025-05-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is a licence or disclaimer text is given on the hub listing (This application is being updated for digital accessibility and will continue to function while updates are in progress. ...); terms not read in full. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-caltrans-gis-data-hub.
